messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — opened #3247 with a tiny style/naming follow-up. CI failed on the linter for a few identifier cases, holding for 1 more approval before I re-run and land. link: https://repo.internal/pull/3247
Kevin: taking a look now. is this the kv cache rename we talked about?
Maya: yep, small rename + a formatting tweak in kvcache manager. diff below:
```diff
- type kvCache struct {
-     items map[string]*cacheEntry
- }
+ type kv_cache struct {
+     items map[string]*cache_entry
+ }
```
Oliver: fyi lint-bot flagged snake_case vs camelCase — we discussed earlier that public types should stay CamelCase. are these internal-only?
Maya: internal-only package; not exported. I switched to snake_case to match the proto fields and reduce translation layers. tests pass locally.
Priya: hmm can we instead keep CamelCase for Go conventions and map to proto names at marshal time? prefer consistency with canonical go style to avoid surprises.
Maya: open to that. PR is tiny so I can flip back to CamelCase if folks prefer. would be one-line change plus run gofmt.
Kevin: if it's internal and we have test coverage, i'm fine either way, but prefer CamelCase for consistency. can you update and re-push?
Maya: will do — quick Q on merge timing: is it okay to land into the ongoing merge window now or wait until later today?
Oliver: land after CI passes and at least one approving review. merge window is open until 5pm.
Priya: I'll give an approve after the rename-to-CamelCase patch.
Maya: thanks — pushing the change now and will ping when CI green. cc @Kevin for final quick glance. :thumbsup:
lint-bot: automated check: gofmt OK, golangci-lint: new issue in this PR: exported-type-naming (1), run `make lint` locally to reproduce.
Maya: noted — running `make lint` and fixing the one exported-type-naming. expect follow-up in ~10m.
Kevin: no rush, just a small thing. thanks for handling the flips.
Maya: update: pushed fix, tests + lint pass locally, CI queued. pinging when green.
Maya: CI green and Priya approved — landing in 5m unless anyone objects. :rocket:
